title: The bat bomb that bombed its own base
caption:
The US military strapped tiny firebombs to bats. The bats set fire to the US military. 🦇🔥
The plan relied on bats roosting under roofs, so each little timed incendiary would end up hidden inside a building. They did exactly that, on their own airfield.
Worst weapon of WW2, or secretly a genius idea? Defend your answer.
first_comment: The bats completed the mission flawlessly. Wrong target, perfect execution 🦇 Bats 1, generals 0
sources: Air & Space Forces Magazine, 'The Bat Bombers' and Wikipedia 'Bat bomb' (Project X-Ray): bats fitted with small timed incendiaries were meant to be released from a bomb-shaped casing and roost in buildings

On 15 May 1943 armed bats accidentally released at the Carlsbad Army Airfield Auxiliary Air Base, New Mexico, roosted under a fuel tank and set the base on fire, including a general's car (American Heritage; Wikipedia 'Bat bomb')
The program cost about $2 million and was cancelled in 1944 because it would not be combat-ready until mid-1945 (Wikipedia 'Bat bomb')
